svg.title: Figure 2 — Escrow lifecycle and authorization: who signs each boundless-events transition, how the escrow pool moves, and which ledger accounts are credited
svg.text: signed XDR via RPC · require_auth() verifies the chip signer
Managed wallets are signed by the backend under envelope encryption; the admin quorum is never server-held. Crowdfunding releases also need the 2-of-3 admin (rose chip).
owner-only funds · start_cancel refunds the owner inline · Active → Cancelled
